from src.nodes.base import BaseNode
import json

class Hou_Mcp_Ai_Execute(BaseNode):
    name = "hou_mcp_ai_execute"

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-START]
        self.add_input("plan",              "any")
        self.add_input("plan_json",         "string", widget_type="text",     default="")
        self.add_input("dry_run",           "bool",   widget_type="checkbox", default=False)
        self.add_input("require_approval",  "bool",   widget_type="checkbox", default=False)
        self.add_input("approver",          "string", widget_type="text",     default="")
        self.add_input("rollback_on_error", "bool",   widget_type="checkbox", default=True)
        self.add_output("ok",                 "bool")
        self.add_output("status",             "string")
        self.add_output("transaction_id",     "string")
        self.add_output("operations_executed","list")
        self.add_output("graph_diff",         "any")
        self.add_output("errors",             "list")
        self.add_output("warnings",           "list")
        self.add_output("approval_status",    "string")
        self.add_output("explanation",        "string")
        self.add_output("report_json",        "string")
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-END]

    async def execute(self, inputs):
        from src.runtime import houdini_runtime
        from src.runtime.transaction_manager import get_transaction_manager
        from src.runtime.scene_cache import get_scene_cache
        from src.runtime.approval_pipeline import get_approval_pipeline
        from src.runtime.execution_explainer import get_execution_explainer

        _empty = {
            "exec_out": True, "ok": False, "status": "failed",
            "transaction_id": "", "operations_executed": [],
            "graph_diff": {}, "errors": [], "warnings": [],
            "approval_status": "", "explanation": "", "report_json": "{}"
        }

        # Resolve plan
        plan = inputs.get("plan")
        if not plan:
            raw = inputs.get("plan_json") or ""
            if raw:
                try:
                    plan = json.loads(raw)
                except Exception as exc:
                    _empty["errors"] = [f"plan_json parse error: {exc}"]
                    return _empty

        if not plan or not isinstance(plan, dict):
            _empty["errors"] = ["No plan provided. Wire a plan dict or plan_json string."]
            return _empty

        if not plan.get("ok", False):
            _empty["errors"] = ["Plan is not valid (ok=False). Run hou_mcp_ai_preview first."]
            _empty["errors"] += plan.get("errors", [])
            return _empty

        dry_run         = bool(inputs.get("dry_run", False))
        require_approval= bool(inputs.get("require_approval", False))
        approver        = str(inputs.get("approver") or "operator").strip()
        rb_err          = bool(inputs.get("rollback_on_error", True))

        # Approval gate
        pipeline = get_approval_pipeline()
        approval_status = "not_required"

        needs_approval = require_approval or pipeline.requires_approval(plan)
        if needs_approval and not dry_run:
            req_id = pipeline.submit_for_approval(plan, submitter="hou_mcp_ai_execute")
            if approver:
                # Operator name supplied → auto-approve on behalf of named approver
                pipeline.approve(req_id, approver=approver, notes="Approved via node input.")
                approval_status = "approved"
            else:
                _empty["status"]          = "pending_approval"
                _empty["approval_status"] = "pending"
                _empty["errors"] = [
                    "Plan requires approval. Supply an 'approver' name to authorize execution, "
                    "or set require_approval=false if the plan is pre-validated."
                ]
                return _empty
        elif not needs_approval:
            approval_status = "auto"

        # Build ops from plan
        ops = plan.get("operations", [])
        if not ops:
            _empty["errors"] = ["Plan contains no operations."]
            return _empty

        if dry_run:
            explainer = get_execution_explainer()
            dry_result = {
                "ok": True, "status": "validated", "transaction_id": None,
                "operations_executed": [], "graph_diff": {}, "errors": [],
                "warnings": plan.get("warnings", []), "intent": plan.get("intent", "")
            }
            expl = explainer.explain_execution(dry_result)
            return {
                "exec_out": True, "ok": True, "status": "validated",
                "transaction_id": "", "operations_executed": [],
                "graph_diff": {}, "errors": [], "warnings": plan.get("warnings", []),
                "approval_status": approval_status,
                "explanation": expl.get("full_text", ""),
                "report_json": json.dumps(dry_result, default=str),
            }

        # Execute via transaction
        cache = get_scene_cache()
        cache.clear_dirty_state()
        mgr  = get_transaction_manager()
        intent = plan.get("intent") or "ai_plan"
        txn_id = await mgr.begin_transaction(f"ai_plan:{intent}", metadata={"plan_id": plan.get("plan_id","")})

        ops_executed = []
        status = "pending"
        errors = []
        warnings = list(plan.get("warnings", []))

        try:
            for op in ops:
                recorded = await houdini_runtime.execute_operation(op)
                await mgr.record_operation(txn_id, recorded)
                ops_executed.append(recorded)
                if recorded.get("status") == "failed":
                    errors.append(recorded.get("error") or "op failed")
                    if rb_err:
                        await mgr.rollback_transaction(txn_id)
                        status = "rolled_back"
                    else:
                        await mgr.mark_failed(txn_id, errors[-1])
                        status = "failed"
                    break

            if status == "pending":
                await mgr.commit_transaction(txn_id)
                status = "committed"
        except Exception as exc:
            errors.append(f"execution exception: {exc}")
            try:
                await mgr.rollback_transaction(txn_id)
            except Exception:
                pass
            status = "rolled_back"

        graph_diff = cache.get_dirty_nodes()

        exec_result = {
            "ok": status == "committed", "status": status,
            "transaction_id": txn_id, "operations_executed": ops_executed,
            "graph_diff": graph_diff, "errors": errors,
            "warnings": warnings, "intent": intent,
        }
        explainer = get_execution_explainer()
        expl = explainer.explain_execution(exec_result)

        report = dict(exec_result)
        report["plan_id"] = plan.get("plan_id", "")

        return {
            "exec_out":            True,
            "ok":                  exec_result["ok"],
            "status":              status,
            "transaction_id":      txn_id,
            "operations_executed": ops_executed,
            "graph_diff":          graph_diff,
            "errors":              errors,
            "warnings":            warnings,
            "approval_status":     approval_status,
            "explanation":         expl.get("full_text", ""),
            "report_json":         json.dumps(report, default=str),
        }

def register_node():
    return Hou_Mcp_Ai_Execute
